artifacts.notes: Normalized transcription, not a facsimile or critical edition. Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup and translations have separate rights. Historical witness: Acta Apostolicae Sedis 21 (1929), pp. 547-548. Uncollated normalized web transcription; source wording and numbering retained apart from the explicitly recorded corrections and apparatus exclusions. The English/Italian index association supplies another act title and 23 February 1929; this Latin delivery is Monasterii Sanctae Mariae, dated 18 September 1928 in its signature and AAS 21 (1929), p. 548. The official indexes give conflicting act dates. The reviewed act date is 1928-09-18, identified at https://www.vatican.va/archive/aas/documents/AAS-21-1929-ocr.pdf printed pp. 547–548; dating clause and signature p. 548.
artifacts.rights_basis: Original historical wording identified in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 21 (1929), pp. 547-548, published by 1930. United States expired-term assessment under 17 U.S.C. 304 and 305; qualifying foreign restoration under 104A(a)(1)(B) receives only the remainder of that term. The preexisting wording remains distinct from modern HTML, creative revision and translations under 103(b). See src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml for the primary authorities and jurisdictional limits.
